messages:
sam: Quick check — we're planning an inference stress test next Thu 6pm PT. Vendor warned of a possible H100 rack delay. Do we have soft quota headroom in us-west2 to run 4 H100s for ~2 hours? Need a decision by EOD.
elaine: tagging infra folks. @raj you handle quota requests, right?
raj: Yep. On it. I can run a quick quota query now.
raj: Running: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --project=redwood-inference | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'`
raj: Result: current usage 12, limit 12 (H100 shows as generic GPUs) — so no headroom. We can request a temporary increase but it depends on vendor fill. :grimacing:
sam: Ugh. Is there any nearby region with spare capacity we can use for the test (latency still acceptable)?
lynne: eu-west1 has ~8 spare GPUs but latency to our test harness will be higher. Could do a smoke run there if acceptable.
elaine: Another option: run mixed-sku (2×H100 + 2×A100) and let the runtime fallback—might satisfy the test without full H100s.
raj: Technically feasible, but need to validate model perf on A100 for the critical paths. Also procurement needs to sign off on cross-sku billing. @procurement any quick take?
procurement: We can route a temporary quota bump request to the vendor if you provide justification. Please open an INF ticket with start/end times, expected GPU-hours, and billing center (use `platform-experiments`). We'll attach vendor justification and request expedited handling.
sam: Done — created INF-4125 with the test plan and linked vendor convo: https://vendor.example.com/threads/9832
raj: OK. I'll open the quota request from our side. Example (mock): `gcloud compute quota-request --region=us-west2 --quota=gpus --amount=4 --reason='Thu stress test INF-4125'`
oncall-bot: FYI: quota increases typically take 24–72h to approve. Please ensure you have a fallback plan.
elaine: Fallback plan suggestion: run 2×H100 in eu-west1 (if vendor can provision there) + 2×A100 in us-west2 and use routing policy. Add route rule `region_preference: [us-west2, eu-west1]` and a fallback variant in the model catalog.
raj: I'll prepare the routing PR and a tiny perf matrix (p50/p95 + token cost) to validate mixed-sku impact.
sam: Great. If vendor confirms a delay we'll flip to mixed-sku. Ping here when quota request is submitted.
raj: Submitted request (mock id Q-9902) at 1829000365 — I'll update when vendor replies. :thumbsup:
sam: Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround.
thread_summary: Quick infra coordination: check us-west2 H100 quota for a Thu stress test, no headroom; procurement and infra to file quota request INF-4125; fallback plan to mixed-sku (H100+ A100) and possible eu-west1 smoke run; request submitted (Q-9902).
